blurb: The State of New Hampshire has a short stretch of coastline, but Hampton Beach offers everything that summer visitors love about the ocean in one vacation destination. In Hampton Beach, you will enjoy a pristine stretch of beach that was recently named one of four “Superstar” beaches in the United States, due to perfect water quality testing results for three consecutive years.
